variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Always use 'my' to declare variables with lexical scope (requires 'use strict').

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Context (scalar vs list) governs how data types behave. Perl 5.36+ introduces true/false booleans.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Use ==, !=, <, > for numbers, and eq, ne, lt, gt for strings. 'defined-or' (//) is preferred over logical OR (||) for defaults.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Postfix modifiers ('if', 'unless') are idiomatic for single statements.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: 'for' and 'foreach' are synonymous in Perl. Iterating over a list aliases the loop variable to the elements.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: 'while' executes while true, 'until' executes while false.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Modern Perl uses signatures. Traditional subroutines unpack arguments from the '@_' array.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Use 'map' and 'grep' for transforming and filtering lists. '@' is for the whole array, '$' is for elements.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Hashes (%) are associative arrays. Use '=>' (fat comma) for readability. Check existence with 'exists'.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Modern Perl supports try/catch syntax. Legacy code uses eval {} and checks the $@ variable.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Perl provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Perl supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Perl provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Perl converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Perl represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Perl formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Perl branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Perl defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Perl iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Perl organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Perl stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Perl groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Perl tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Perl organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
